title: Controlled source provenance
description: Every controlled operational fact carries provenance. `verified: false` means the value has NOT been reconciled against the controlling document and must not be presented to a technician as authoritative.

document.description: Controlling document reference, e.g. 'C07', 'I01', 'RWP 850'. Use the literal string 'SOURCE_REQUIRED' when the controlling document has not been supplied.

verified.description: True only when a named reviewer has checked the value against the controlling document revision.
